judge_output.rationale: The waste-heat hypothesis behind the card has been tested only at the level of whole galaxies: the Ĝ papers use WISE mid-IR colours of about 1e5 galaxies (2014ApJ...792...27W, 2015ApJS..217...25G), and Curtis et al. 2026 fit SPS models with a Dyson-sphere component to 129 galaxies. Garrett 2015 proposed comparing resolved kpc-scale mid-IR and radio images to find partly occupied galaxies but did not run that test, and Curtis et al. 2026 list resolved fitting as a future step. No listed work maps a spatially resolved 4-5 um excess in the LMC, SMC, M31 or M33 with SPHEREx spectra and star-formation tracers removed. The card is therefore a resolved, spectrally decomposed extension of a tested integrated-galaxy claim, and also runs a test that has only been proposed.

closest_prior.relation: Searched WISE extended-source photometry of about 1e5 galaxies for integrated mid-IR waste-heat excess; it used whole-galaxy colours, not resolved sub-kpc maps of Local Group galaxies with PAH, Br-alpha and 24 um dust removed.

Proposed comparing resolved kpc-scale mid-IR and radio images to identify partial Type II/III civilisations but did not perform a resolved analysis; the card would run a spatially resolved version with SPHEREx.

Set per-galaxy integrated limits on Dyson-swarm covering fraction in 129 galaxies using SPS fits, and proposes resolved fitting as a future step; it does not include resolved patch searches in Local Group galaxies.
Set up the waste-heat formalism and gave a zeroth-order null result for Type III civilisations from integrated WISE photometry; the test is not spatially resolved.

judge_output.what_would_make_it_open: A friends-of-friends search for contiguous regions larger than 100 pc with more than 20 per cent 4-5 um excess in resolved SPHEREx spectral maps of the LMC, SMC, M31 and M33, after removing PAH, Br-alpha and 24 um-traced dust, has not been done by any listed work and would be the new contribution.
